name: Ajax Command Page Reload
description: Provides a custom Drupal AJAX command (PageReloadCommand) that reloads the current page from an AjaxResponse.
project_description: Reload the current page from JS. Provides a PageReloadCommand for use with Drupal's AjaxResponse: $response->addCommand(new PageReloadCommand()). The command attaches its own JS library which registers a Drupal.AjaxCommands.prototype.pageReload handler that calls window.location = window.location.href (reloading the current URL, using history.replaceState to avoid form resubmission).
